mechanism: Vitamin K antagonizes warfarin's anticoagulant effects, and dronedarone may potentiate warfarin metabolism, creating conflicting anticoagulation control if vitamin K supplementation is used concurrently in patients on dual therapy.
action: Monitor INR closely if vitamin K supplementation is necessary in patients taking dronedarone with warfarin; maintain consistent vitamin K intake and consider alternative anticoagulants (DOACs) if possible.
